This Overlay District Is Intended to Cluster Development Close to Roads to Ensure Sufficient Corridors For Wildlife And Establish Buffer Zones. Written Review Of Impact On The Surrounding Wildlife By The Vermont Department Of Fish And Wildlife Is Require For Development.
